stem: Which event was one cause of the U.S.-Mexican War?

options.label: F
options.text: The United States banned slavery in territories acquired from Mexico.

options.label: G
options.text: The U.S. Congress debated statehood for New Mexico.

options.label: H
options.text: U.S. and Mexican soldiers fought over disputed territory north of the Rio Grande.

options.label: J
options.text: The United States acquired the Mexican Cession.
